item: F50 (editor) and new work: human review provenance, person sign-in, feedback lane, admin section, CRM with Gmail
summary: Dinis directs: stories should have an editor; the site records which humans reviewed each story, each person signing in with their own PKI key; an append lane takes feedback from the site, and a signed-in person agreeing with an article counts as a signed review; human journalists and researchers are added so they can sign articles, building provenance, including when authors or sources are contacted to validate; a CRM connected to Gmail for contacting people about the site; all of it in a rich admin section through which Dinis works with the site.
found_by_recorder: it already has PKI sign-in at /login/ (P-256 keys issued by the conductor as a QR link, public halves in board/person-keys.json, 2 keys) and a signed-in area at /newsroom/ (200)
it already has an append lane pattern: board/lanes/signups.json, sealed write-only appends to an SG/Send vault, drained by conductor@web-summit.dinis into the Web Summit team's private CRM
routed_to: cl-6.conductor, to brief cl-6.dev, cl-6.designer and cl-6.security (design first, nothing live before security's review)
stays_with_dinis: issuing each person key (trust in keys), one line per person, after that person agrees
naming any human editor or reviewer on the site, only with that person's consent
the Gmail connector: which agent, which mailbox, read or send; nothing is sent in his name without his line
the CRM holding private people's details: where it lives and who reads it, with cl-6.counsel's view on data protection

authority.dinis_words: Yeah, so should have an editor. So the other thing that we need to add to here, we need to add a way and need to capture which humans have reviewed the story, and we need to allow each of us to log in with our own PKI key to the website. [...] We need a CRM for this [...] connection between the CRM and a Gmail. [...] So this should be on the admin section [...] And I should now start to interact with this website through the admin section.

status: in-force: design and build routed; the four items above wait on Dinis
